decisions.reason: Attributes the failure to fs-ext@2.1.1 dependency of dsh-session-persistence-jsonl, its node-gyp configure build script, and the missing Visual Studio toolchain, with log evidence.
Shows the top-level static flock import forces fs-ext to load even on Windows, so --ignore-scripts only defers failure to first require at boot.

Clearly separates Windows acquireLockHandleWin32 named-semaphore locking from POSIX flock on session.lock, and uses this to justify an import-safe Windows stub while the semaphore path stays authoritative.

Follows the node-pty patchedDependencies precedent: platform-gated patch that skips node-gyp on Windows and provides a pure-JS fallback flock with callback-invoking shape, registered in pnpm-workspace.yaml, with reinstall, load, and service-boot verification.
Explicitly refuses Visual Studio and upstream modifications, using only the repository-managed patch mechanism.
Cites full DSH-0.1.3-A1-03 and connects it to the fs-ext install failure, the static-import reason, and the pnpm-patch Windows plan.

caps.reason: Plan explicitly excludes installing Visual Studio/Build Tools.
Rejects --ignore-scripts and makes the imported entry loadable via the patch.
Uses the repository-managed patch mechanism; no upstream edits required.
Windows keeps the named-semaphore path; the no-op flock stub applies only to the dead Windows branch and POSIX keeps real flock.
